source: Retained ProRAW from the user's iPhone. Read-only TIFF/IFD metadata extraction; no rendering or profile modification.
interpretation: These are the embedded color-characterization matrices for this DNG's declared reference camera space, not measured sensor spectral-sensitivity functions.

DNG ColorMatrix describes XYZ to reference camera color coordinates. Interpretation also requires AnalogBalance, camera calibration/white balance, illuminant selection and the rest of the DNG pipeline.
This file is already a computational ProRAW; its embedded matrices must not be assumed to describe untouched physical sensor values or every capture mode of this phone.
These matrices are not an iPhone-to-Hasselblad rendering transform and should not simply be applied again to CIRAWFilter's color-managed extended-linear-sRGB output.
ProfileToneCurve and ProfileGainTableMap presence and element counts are recorded; their full payloads were not extracted here.
Rational matrix coefficients are shown as Float64 decimal quotients; the original DNG retains the exact rational values.
